workarounds.note: headings.levels[0] restates breakBefore: { enabled: true, parity: 'any' }: in 1.4.1 any headings object drops the documented H1 page break, and the cover and contents styles inherit this one
col() writes each colour's hex beside its paletteId: the document palette does not reach design elements (openers, running heads, the cover) or bodyText.referenceColor in 1.4.1

the contents numerals are Gloock at 0.3 × 15 ÷ 0.3125 = 14.4 pt beside 15 pt Gloock titles: 1.4.1 centres an entry's number (textBaseline 'middle') 0.3 × the entry size above the baseline, and Chrome puts Gloock's middle 0.3125 em above its baseline, so the 14.4 pt numeral stands on the title's baseline (measured 0.04 mm off); a 12 pt numeral rode 0.32 mm high, and a Hanken Grotesk 8.5 pt one (middle 0.2675 em) about 0.8 mm

the cover and contents styles inherit the level's breakBefore, parity 'any', which is what puts the contents on page 2 without a :::pagebreak; the 'Open every essay on a recto' Variation has to restate 'any' on both styles, or the contents inherit 'odd' and open on page 3 behind a blank verso

the cover style sets span: 'page' in this single-column book only so that its bleed-anchored dusk paints to the page edges: a heading design kept in the column is clipped at the column's top and bottom edges, which leaves 20 mm of paper above the art and 22 mm below it
the essay numeral is {number} from numberingTemplate '{1:I}'; {numberRoman} prints nothing in a chapter opener in 1.4.1
a :::space{lines=1} (one 12.5 pt line of the note's leading) separates the colophon from the note on the contents page: the colophon style's marginTop is ignored inside a box
bodyText.maxRuntTracking is 0: a runt fix's negative tracking is measured but not painted in 1.4.1, so word spacing alone shortens runts

the lines of verse Hazlitt quotes are a :::paragraphs{style="verse"} container, one paragraph per line in *italics*, not a Markdown blockquote: 1.4.1 paints a blockquote in a hard-coded #666666 italic, with the body's first-line indent and no side indent, and no colour or indent setting reaches it
